base_commit_note: The PR was rebased before merge — the parent of merge commit c5fc15685202cda73f7c3f5c6f299b0945f58508 is a81849b0..., and solution.patch / eval_tests.patch apply cleanly there but not at the PR-creation-time tip. We use a81849b0 as the authoritative base_commit for this instance.

out_of_scope_surfaces.reason: After source-symbol cleanup, the selected TestCParser F2P methods are the six parser-generator behavior tests whose selected bodies do not directly name PR-added source symbols absent from the requirement doc. The other two test_peg_generator classes — TestPegen tests the pegen Python module's grammar-parsing internals, TestFirstSets tests the first-sets static analysis — are pure-Python unit tests of the build-time tool with no runtime parsing component. Including them would inflate F2P without adding orthogonal system-level coverage.

This upstream test is decorated `@unittest.skipIf(sys.flags.use_peg, 'This tests nothing for now, since compile uses pegen as well')`. Since solution.patch makes PEG the default (config->use_peg=1), the test SKIPs at post-state. Per the LoLBench no-skipped-tests rule, SKIPPED cannot count as PASSED, so the test cannot be in F2P; the runner does not pass -X oldparser. The other ASTGenerationTest methods were removed from the selected F2P set during source-symbol cleanup because their selected bodies directly invoke parse_string, which is absent from the requirement doc.

out_of_scope_surfaces.surface: Six pre-existing test methods adjacent to PR hunks but not themselves modified: test_codeop.CodeopTests.test_valid, test_compile.TestSpecifics.test_single_statement, test_eof.EOFTestCase.test_EOFS, test_parser.ParserStackLimitTestCase.test_deeply_nested_list, test_positional_only_arg.PositionalOnlyTestCase.test_lambdas, test_unparse.UnparseTestCase.test_constant_tuples
out_of_scope_surfaces.reason: These methods sit immediately before the actually-modified methods in their files, so git's diff hunk-context shows their function header in the `@@ … def test_X(self):` line — but the changes are to the NEXT method, not to these. Their bodies are byte-identical between base_commit and merge_commit. Confirmed by AST-walk: the methods themselves contain no `sys.flags.use_peg` reference, so their pre-state behavior would be identical to post-state — disqualifying them as F2P (no transition). The actually-modified peers in the same files (test_codeop.test_incomplete, test_compile.test_bad_single_statement, test_eof.test_line_continuation_EOF, test_parser.test_trigger_memory_error, test_positional_only_arg.test_invalid_syntax_*, test_unparse.test_function_type) use the `@unittest.skipIf(sys.flags.use_peg, …)` decorator pattern; at post-state PEG is the default → those methods SKIP → SKIPPED ≠ PASSED, also disqualifying them from F2P under the no-skipped-tests rule.

eval_tests_patch_notes: eval_tests.patch is based on the PR's test hunks for the 7 added Lib/test/test_peg_parser*/test_peg_generator* files plus 18 modified Lib/test/test_*.py files. mutant_set_revision.note: Seven parse-mode mutants were removed as §6-unreachable. mutant_001 (eval-start-vs-exec-start flip in Modules/_peg_parser.c, _Py_parse_string) plus mutant_006/007/008/010/038/039 all mutate the mode/encoding/default-start behavior of the test-facing _peg_parser extension module (Modules/_peg_parser.c and Tools/peg_generator/peg_extension/peg_extension.c). That behavior is observable only through _peg_parser.parse_string / parse_file (PR-added symbols whose mode semantics are absent from requirement_docs/CPython_PEP-617_New-PEG-parser-for-CPython_PR-19503.md, and which the bundle's own out_of_scope_surfaces / triage policy excludes). Public compile()/eval()/exec()/ast.parse() route through PyPegen_ASTFromStringObject with the caller-supplied start mode and never reach the mutated lines, so no §6-compliant committed test can distinguish them from golden. They were deleted from mutations/ and from this spec's targets_mutants; 31 mutants remain. Additionally, 7 PEG-generator-internal mutants (m005/m012/m013/m027 c_generator, m018 python_generator cut, m029/m034 loop0/repeat0) were removed: per-test container runs on 2026-06-17 confirmed none is killable through any §6-eligible committed test that runs cleanly in this harness — TestCParser has no targeted optional/repeat unit and its only full-codegen test (test_correct_ast_generation_on_source_files) errors on golden; the only Python cut test (TestPegen.test_cut) prints a verbose parse trace to stdout that corrupts run_tests.sh's results JSON; and no committed pegen test parses an empty repetition, so loop0/repeat0 codegen flips are unobservable. 24 mutants remain, all killed by union (golden green F2P 25/25, P2P 57/57).
